business_problem: However, as the company grew, they faced significant challenges in managing and extracting value from their expanding data landscape.
solution_summary: Estapar, Brazil’s largest parking network, sought to optimize the parking customer experience by gaining real-time insights into parking usage and demand. The company needed to consolidate transactions across their facilities and forecast future demand. With the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Estapar was able to unify data across multiple sources, enabling smarter decision-making, efficient performance monitoring and personalized services. As a result, Estapar reduced data processing time from three days to real-time, improved demand forecasting accuracy, and empowered business teams with self-service analytics, driving a significant boost in operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
business_outcome: Estapar achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 3x Faster license plate analysis — from 3 days to real time; 600+ Data sources unified for more holistic decision-making; 20x Productivity boost — delivering the work of 100+ people with just 5.
